Home.title: Visualize Your Organization
Home.subtitle: OrgaChart provides a simple and powerful solution to create and manage organizational charts for your team. Secure, scalable, and easy to use.

Admin.title: Admin Panel
Admin.description: Manage users and their chart assignments.
Admin.noteDescription: For this demonstration, user data is stored in memory and will reset when the auth provider re-initializes. Changes are not persisted on the server.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.welcome: Welcome, {email}. Here is your assigned content.
Dashboard.noChartDescription: There is currently no chart assigned to your account. Please contact an administrator.

AssignIframeDialog.title: Assign Chart
AssignIframeDialog.description: Set or update the Chart URL for {email}. Leave empty to remove.
AssignIframeDialog.successDescription: Chart URL for {email} has been updated.

LoginForm.title: Welcome Back

LoginForm.errorDescription: Invalid email or password. Please try again.
